park.name: Biidaasige Park

features.name: Playground (west, unnamed in OSM)
features.evidence: Current OSM maps an UNNAMED leisure=playground area west of Old Fire Hall 30. It is a generic west play-AREA anchor, NOT the Owl structure and NOT a body footprint. The named Snowy Owl Theatre structure (way/1418541992) now proves the Owl is within this area, so this polygon stays a generic area only. The maker pin remains an approximate manufacturer point, not a body origin.

features.name: Snowy Owl Play Theatre
features.evidence: Current OSM maps way/1418541992 (area=yes, name='Snowy Owl Theatre', playground=structure, 18 vertices). The theatre AREA is exact: every vertex lies inside the unnamed western playground area (way/1418127159), proving the Owl is in that play area, west of Old Fire Hall 30. The polygon covers stage and nest, so its centroid is the mapped area's reference point, NOT the Owl body-base origin. The body-base point still comes from the Captain's orthophoto interpretation, not from this ring.
features.areaNote: Theatre area includes stage and nest; do not treat the centroid as a body footprint origin.

features.name: Cableway (short, published 20 m cableway)
features.evidence: Current OSM maps way/1552431730 as playground=zipwire, two endpoints. City publishes a 20 m cableway; the measured map line (endpoint-to-endpoint) is kept separate from the published 20 m and differs by the mapping tolerance, not a survey.

features.name: Cableway (long, published 40 m cableway)
features.evidence: Current OSM maps way/1552431733 as playground=zipwire, two endpoints. City publishes a 40 m cableway; the measured map line is kept separate from the published 40 m and may differ slightly.

features.name: Swing Hill (mapped swing point)
features.evidence: Current OSM maps a single playground=swing node (43.6456141,-79.3505259). This is a PARTIAL swing source: the orthophoto shows two swing pads/frames, so one mapped node does not prove one total seat or a full installation.

features.name: Sandpit (unnamed in OSM)
features.evidence: Current OSM maps way/1552431731 as playground=sandpit inside the Badlands Scramble area. Generic sandpit identity only; it is NOT proven to be the mock beaver dam.

features.name: Sandpit (unnamed in OSM)
features.evidence: Current OSM maps way/1552431732 as playground=sandpit, a separate sand pit between the swing and Badlands. Generic identity only; it is NOT proven to be the mock beaver dam, so it is not assigned to it.

features.name: Playground structure (unnamed, identity unresolved)
features.evidence: Current OSM maps a single unnamed playground=structure node (43.6455508,-79.3500972) inside the Badlands Scramble polygon. Its identity is unresolved: it is NOT verified as a Dodem animal and NOT a beaver dam.
